tools.name: flow_list_steps
tools.description: List the steps of the Flow registry: id, title, ports, where each runs and whether it runs natively.

tools.name: flow_describe_step
tools.description: Describe one step: parameters, algorithms, presets and references.

tools.name: flow_get_plan
tools.description: Return the current plan in canonical form with its problems.

tools.name: flow_check
tools.description: Check a proposed plan and return its problems.

tools.name: flow_propose_plan
tools.description: Propose a whole plan, shown to the user as a proposal.

tools.name: flow_add_step
tools.description: Add a step to the plan; its inputs are wired automatically.

tools.name: flow_set_param
tools.description: Set a parameter of a step instance; the value follows the schema of the parameter.
